**Finding submitted: deviation (critical rule IP), confidence 0.82.**

What I found in § 4 (Ownership of Materials Related to Services; Acceptance):

- **§ 4(a) (p0017)** declares the Works "the property of Company" but includes **no assignment of IP rights** and qualifies ownership with a vague "to the extent ... invoiced and said invoice has been paid" test — leaving rights in work product we fund potentially unallocated or with RadialSpark.
- **No Customer Data provision anywhere** in the agreement; meanwhile § 4(b)(i) claims broad Contractor ownership of materials including "data," and § 4(b)(ii) restricts our use of Contractor records.
- Acceptable as drafted: § 4(b) Contractor background IP retention and § 4(c) perpetual, royalty-free, sublicensable licence-back for embedded Contractor's Information — these already match the playbook, so no change proposed there.

Redline (validated ok:true, preferred level, modelled on seed-ip precedent):

1. **p0017** — replaced the payment-conditioned ownership language with an express irrevocable assignment of all right, title and interest (including IP rights) in the Works, effective on payment of the undisputed amount of the covering invoice (preserving the commercial bargain).
2. **New § 4(e) after p0022** — Company retains all rights in Company Data (including derived data) and our pre-existing IP, neither is "Contractor's Information," nothing assigns them to Contractor, and no joint ownership.
